title: hkdf-sha256 — case shape (v0.2)
description: Pins byte-level cases for protocol::derive_subkey_v0_2, the HKDF-SHA-256 helper that derives a subkey from root_key with salt=zero_32 and info='myne.v0.2 '||role. The v0.2 category exists for roles that must NOT live in the v0.1 category, whose envelope promises v0.1 info bytes: 'membership-key', the KEK for the sealed vault membership field (vault.meta §9.3.1, NTV5-only), and 'person-vault-carrier', the KEK for the device-local vault-bound person-identity carrier (myne-md/myne#792). The Rust reference implementation lives at protocol/src/subkey.rs (main myne repository); spec contract is docs/spec/protocol.md §3.2 (HKDF construction) + §3.4 (role registry) + §10.7 (v0.2 prefixes).

vector_id.description: Stable identifier of the form 'hkdf-sha256/v0.2/<descriptive-slug>'. Immutable once shipped.

input_root_key_hex.description: 32-byte root_key (hex). HKDF Extract phase consumes this as the IKM under salt=zero_32.

input_role.description: Registered role string (spec §3.4). 'membership-key' is the KEK for the sealed vault membership field (vault.meta §9.3.1, the account/vault split, decisions.md 2026-09-07): DISTINCT from the AAD role 'membership-blob' used by aad_membership_blob. 'person-vault-carrier' is the KEK for the device-local vault-bound person-identity carrier (<app_config_dir>/person-vault-carriers/<vault_id_hex>.json, myne-md/myne#792): DISTINCT from the AAD role 'person-vault-carrier-blob' used by aad_person_vault_carrier. 'awareness-room-id' and 'awareness-key' are the two live-collaboration awareness roles (live-collab, decisions/sync/0655): 'awareness-room-id' derives an identifier (the per-note room id), DISTINCT from the AAD role 'awareness-frame' used by aad_awareness_frame; 'awareness-key' is the frame KEK. Any future v0.2-prefix role extends this enum in lockstep with the spec registry, additive only, immutable for existing variants.

informational_info_utf8_hex.description: Informational — the canonical HKDF info bytes the helper assembles from the (prefix, role) pair: '"myne.v0.2 "' (10 bytes, trailing space included) concatenated with the role string (no separator, no length prefix). Hex-encoded UTF-8 bytes. Not consumed by the runner — verified implicitly via the expected_subkey_hex assertion; carried so independent implementers verifying their port assemble the same info parameter can do so without re-parsing the spec. Optional per-vector.

expected_subkey_hex.description: Full 32-byte subkey output (hex, lowercase, no 0x prefix). Implementations decode input_root_key_hex + input_role, run their derive_subkey_v0_2 equivalent, hex-encode the output, compare byte-equal.
